mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annualized) indicate stable monetary conditions that support equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% AND CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined as FEDFUNDS rising by at least 0.5% in 3 months), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rise >= 0.5% in 3 months), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 900.0 thousands of units) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances when HOUST > 900.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0 index) signals a weakening economy and reduced corporate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 5.0% (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicates a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is < 0.03.
